_comment: One-off filing-job check requests: a filer whose filing-state last check (c) is BEFORE requestedAt is added to that run's due set (rank 1 in pickCandidates). The check stamps c whatever its outcome, so each request retires itself after one check; an entry left here is inert. Read by lib/server/secFilingCheckRequests.ts. No secret, no manual call: a code change, reviewed like any other.
